SQL_DTL_CTN: SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, C.DEPT_ID AS CODE     , CASE @langCd WHEN 'EN' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_EN           WHEN 'CN' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_CN           ELSE C.DEPT_NAME_KO       END AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A    , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C WHERE 1=1 AND   A.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID AND   A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT UNIT_ID                         FROM   SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A                         WHERE  USER_ID = @sesUserId                         AND    UNIT_TP_CD = 'D') ORDER BY DIVISION_ID, NAME, CODE
SELECT COMPANY_ID AS CODE,COMPANY_ID AS NAME  FROM SCM_MST_COMPANY_SN
SELECT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID 	 , SEGMENT2 AS CODE      , SEGMENT3 AS NAME FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SOLD_CUSTOMER' ORDER BY SEGMENT2
SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE'
SELECT 	COMPANY_ID AS CODE       , COMPANY_ID AS NAME FROM 	SCM_MST_COMPANY_SN

SELECT 	DIVISION_ID AS CODE 	  , DIVISION_ID AS NAME FROM 	SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE  (@divisionId IS NULL OR DIVISION_ID LIKE '%' + @divisionId + '%') 	OR (@divisionId IS NULL OR DIVISION_NAME LIKE '%' + @divisionId + '%') GROUP BY DIVISION_ID ORDER BY DIVISION_ID
SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE 	 , SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INCOTERMS'    AND VALID_YN = 'Y'    AND ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y' ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT DISTINCT      A.DIVISION_ID    , B.DEPT_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE    , A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE    , A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME FROM      SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B        ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID       AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID WHERE  1 = 1 AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND    A.DIVISION_ID IN (          SELECT UNIT_ID          FROM   SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A          WHERE  1=1          AND    USER_ID = @sesUserId          AND    UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'        ) AND    A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY DIVISION_ID, CODE

SELECT  T1.SEGMENT1 CODE, NVL(MSG.MSG_NM, T1.DESCRIPTION) NAME      FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T1 LEFT JOIN  SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG        ON  T1.SEGMENT2 = MSG.MSG_ID       AND  MSG.LANG_CD = @sesLangCd     WHERE  1=1       AND  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'BTN_TP_CD'       AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'  ORDER BY  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE, T1.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT  T1.MNU_ID, COL.SHEET_NAME AS CODE, COL.SHEET_NAME AS NAME     FROM  SCM_ADM_MNU_M T1  LEFT JOIN  SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG         ON  T1.MNU_MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID        AND  MSG.LANG_CD = @sesLangCd  LEFT JOIN  SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS COL         ON  T1.MNU_ID = COL.PROGRAM_ID      WHERE  T1.MNU_TP_CD = 'SCREEN'   GROUP BY  T1.MNU_ID, COL.SHEET_NAME   ORDER BY COL.SHEET_NAME
SELECT YYYY AS CODE, YYYY || '(' || VERSION_NM || ')' AS NAME FROM DM_MST_CONTRIBUTE_VER WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY YYYY DESC
SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DATA_SORT_METHOD'

SELECT  T1.SEGMENT1 CODE, NVL(MSG.MSG_NM, T1.DESCRIPTION) NAME      FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T1 LEFT JOIN  SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG        ON  T1.SEGMENT2 = MSG.MSG_ID       AND  MSG.LANG_CD = @sesLangCd     WHERE  1=1       AND  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INPUT_TP_CD'       AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'  ORDER BY  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE, T1.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT  T1.SEGMENT1 CODE, NVL(MSG.MSG_NM, T1.DESCRIPTION) NAME      FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T1 LEFT JOIN  SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG        ON  T1.SEGMENT2 = MSG.MSG_ID       AND  MSG.LANG_CD = @sesLangCd     WHERE  1=1       AND  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'API_TP_CD'       AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'  ORDER BY  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE, T1.DISPLAY_SEQ
SELECT  T1.SEGMENT1 CODE, T1.SEGMENT2 NAME      FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T1     WHERE  1=1       AND  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'TIME_ZONE'       AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'  ORDER BY  T1.DISPLAY_SEQ
SELECT  T1.SEGMENT1 CODE, T1.SEGMENT2 NAME      FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T1     WHERE  1=1       AND  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'LANGUAGE'       AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'  ORDER BY  T1.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_BIZ_TYPE'
ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ
SELECT 'ALL' AS CODE, 'ALL' AS NAME FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'REPORT_GROUP3'
SELECT  *      FROM  SCM_COM_SYS_LOG     WHERE  1=1       AND  LOG_TP_CD = @logTypeCd  ORDER BY  LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC

SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, B.DEPT_ID,        CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN B.PROJECT_CODE             ELSE A.END_CUSTOMER        END AS CODE,        NVL(D.SEGMENT3, CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN B.PROJECT_CODE                             ELSE A.END_CUSTOMER                        END) AS NAME FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B              ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID             AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D              ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1             AND A.END_CUSTOMER = D.SEGMENT2             AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'             AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.DIVISION_ID IN (     SELECT DISTINCT UNIT_ID AS DIVISION_ID     FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M     WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId       AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' ) AND A.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL ORDER BY DIVISION_ID, DEPT_ID, CODE
SELECT 	  SEGMENT1 AS CODE 	 	, SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM      SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE     (LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CUST_GROUP') AND       VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY  SEGMENT1

SELECT DISTINCT ST.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE, SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE ST WHERE  1 = 1 AND    ST.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND    ST.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND    ST.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT UNIT_ID                         FROM   SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A                         WHERE  USER_ID = @sesUserId                         AND    UNIT_TP_CD = 'D') ORDER BY ST.SCM_SITE_ID ASC

SELECT        L.SEGMENT1  AS CODE,        L.SEGMENT2  AS NAME FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE  1 = 1 AND    L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ITEM_TYPE_CODE' AND    L.VALID_YN    = 'Y' ORDER BY L.DISPLAY_SEQ
SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE 	 , ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_PROD_PROCESS'   AND  VALID_YN = 'Y'

SELECT COMPANY_ID AS CODE,        COMPANY_ID AS NAME FROM (     SELECT COMPANY_ID     FROM SCM_MST_COMPANY_SN     WHERE (@divisionId IS NULL OR LENGTH(@scmSiteId) = 0 OR @scmSiteId = '')     UNION ALL     SELECT COMPANY_ID     FROM SCM_MST_SITE     WHERE (@scmSiteId IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(@scmSiteId) > 0 AND @scmSiteId <> '')       AND ((@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = '') OR DIVISION_ID = @divisionId)       AND ((@scmSiteId IS NULL OR @scmSiteId = '') OR SCM_SITE_ID = @scmSiteId) )

SELECT A.PLANT_ID      AS CODE 	 , A.PLANT_ID      AS NAME   FROM SCM_MST_PLANT_SN A  WHERE (( @divisionId IS NULL OR  @divisionId='' ) OR A.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId )    AND (( @companyId IS NULL OR  @companyId='' ) OR A.COMPANY_ID = @companyId )
SELECT  SEGMENT1 AS CODE 	,	SEGMENT1 AS NAME FROM    SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE   1=1 	AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PROJECT_MODEL_MAPPING' ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT DISTINCT 	A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID,     A.END_CUSTOMER AS CODE,     NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.END_CUSTOMER) AS NAME FROM ( 	SELECT DISTINCT 	     site.DIVISION_ID 	   , site.END_CUSTOMER 	   , item.DEPT_ID, item.PROJECT_CODE 	   , site.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 	   , site.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME 	FROM      SCM_MST_SITE site 	LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM item 	       ON site.DIVISION_ID = item.DIVISION_ID 	      AND site.SCM_SITE_ID = item.SCM_SITE_ID ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D     ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1    AND A.END_CUSTOMER = D.SEGMENT2    AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'    AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y' WHERE 1 = 1 --  AND ( --        (@divisionId = NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL' OR @divisionId = '') --        OR A.DIVISION_ID IN ( --            SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(@divisionId, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) --            FROM DUAL --            CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(@divisionId, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL --        ) --      ) --  AND ( --        (@deptId = NULL OR @deptId = 'ALL' OR @deptId = '') --        OR A.DEPT_ID IN ( --            SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(@deptId, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) --            FROM DUAL --            CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(@deptId, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL --        ) --      ) --  AND A.DIVISION_ID IN ( --        SELECT DISTINCT UNIT_ID --        FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M --        WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId --          AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' --      )   AND A.DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL   AND A.DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL   AND A.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A.END_CUSTOMER

SELECT DISTINCT 	A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, 	A.END_CUSTOMER AS END_CUSTOMER,     A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE,     A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B     ON (@divisionId = '40' AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID) LEFT JOIN (     SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(@endCustomer, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) AS token     FROM DUAL     CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(@endCustomer, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL ) C ON (1=1) WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'   AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'   AND (         @divisionId IS NULL         OR @divisionId = ''         OR @divisionId = 'ALL'         OR A.DIVISION_ID IN (             SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(@divisionId, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)             FROM DUAL             CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(@divisionId, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL         )       )   AND (         @endCustomer IS NULL         OR @endCustomer = ''         OR @endCustomer = 'ALL'         OR (             @divisionId <> '40'             AND A.END_CUSTOMER = CASE                 WHEN @endCustomer = 'ALL' OR @endCustomer = '' THEN A.END_CUSTOMER                 ELSE C.token             END         )         OR (             @divisionId = '40'             AND B.PROJECT_CODE = CASE                 WHEN @endCustomer = 'ALL' OR @endCustomer = '' THEN B.PROJECT_CODE                 ELSE C.token             END         )       )   AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (         SELECT DISTINCT UNIT_ID         FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M         WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId           AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'     ) ORDER BY A.SCM_SITE_ID ASC

SELECT  T1.SEGMENT1 CODE, NVL(MSG.MSG_NM, T1.DESCRIPTION) NAME      FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T1 LEFT JOIN  SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG        ON  T1.SEGMENT2 = MSG.MSG_ID       AND  MSG.LANG_CD = @sesLangCd     WHERE  1=1       AND  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MNU_TP_CD'       AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'  ORDER BY  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE, T1.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT  DISTINCT PROC_NM AS CODE, PROC_NM AS NAME     FROM  SCM_ADM_PROC_M ORDER BY  PROC_NM

SELECT  T1.DIVISION_ID AS CODE, T1.DIVISION_ID || ' ' || MIN(T1.DIVISION_NAME) AS NAME 	FROM  SCM_MST_DIVISION T1 	JOIN  SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M T2 	  ON  T1.DIVISION_ID = T2.UNIT_ID 	 AND  T2.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'    WHERE  1=1 	 AND  T1.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE' 	 AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y' 	 AND  T2.USE_YN = 'Y' 	 AND  T2.USER_ID = @sesUserId GROUP BY  T1.DIVISION_ID, T1.ATTRIBUTE1 ORDER BY  T1.DIVISION_ID || ' ' || MIN(T1.DIVISION_NAME)
SELECT DISTINCT OWNER CODE, OWNER NAME FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_TYPE IN ('TABLE', 'PROCEDURE', 'PACKAGE') ORDER BY OWNER

SELECT  T1.SEGMENT1 CODE, NVL(MSG.MSG_NM, T1.DESCRIPTION) NAME      FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T1 LEFT JOIN  SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG        ON  T1.SEGMENT2 = MSG.MSG_ID       AND  MSG.LANG_CD = @sesLangCd     WHERE  1=1       AND  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE = @lookupType       AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'  ORDER BY  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE, T1.DISPLAY_SEQ
SELECT	G.USER_GR_ID AS CODE, G.USER_GR_NM AS NAME FROM 	SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M G WHERE	G.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY G.USER_GR_ID

SELECT  DISTINCT API_ID CODE, NVL(MSG.MSG_NM, T1.API_MSG_DESC) ||'('||T1.API_ID||')' NAME       FROM  SCM_ADM_API_M T1  LEFT JOIN  SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG         ON  T1.API_MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID        AND  MSG.LANG_CD = @sesLangCd   ORDER BY  NAME

SELECT  T1.MNU_ID CODE, NVL(MSG.MSG_NM, T1.MNU_DESC)||'('||T1.MNU_ID||')' NAME 	  FROM  SCM_ADM_MNU_M T1  LEFT JOIN  SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG         ON  T1.MNU_MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID        AND  MSG.LANG_CD = @sesLangCd      WHERE  T1.MNU_TP_CD = 'SCREEN'   GROUP BY  T1.MNU_ID, MSG.MSG_NM, T1.MNU_DESC

SELECT CODE, NAME FROM (

  AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40'
  AND (NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0)
  AND (NVL(TRIM(@endCustomer), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || A.END_CUSTOMER || ',') > 0)
  AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y')
UNION ALL

FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT U.USER_ID, U.DEPT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D2 ON U.DEPT_ID = D2.DEPT_ID) C
  ON B.OWNER = C.USER_ID
WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(A.OPERATION_GROUP, ' ') <> 'W'
  AND (NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',40,') > 0)
  AND (NVL(TRIM(@deptId), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || C.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0)
  AND (NVL(TRIM(@endCustomer), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || B.PROJECT_CODE || ',') > 0)
  AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y')
UNION ALL

FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON L.SEGMENT3 = B.DIVISION_ID AND L.SEGMENT1 = B.SCM_SITE_ID

     , CASE @langCd WHEN 'EN' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_EN WHEN 'CN' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_CN ELSE C.DEPT_NAME_KO END AS NAME

SELECT DIVISION_ID, DEPT_ID, CODE, NAME FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, B.DEPT_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE AS CODE, NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.PROJECT_CODE) AS NAME
FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO B ON B.USER_ID = TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.OWNER, '[^,]+', 1, 1))
JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID

  ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.SEGMENT2 AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'

FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L

SQL_NM: DMF0021 Cell Prod Site 셀 콤보 (div40 Catch_Up)
SQL_DTL_CTN:
SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE' AND SEGMENT1 = '-' AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
                   WHERE I.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE = 'CELL'
                     AND I.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND I.ITEM_ID = @itemId
                     AND @itemId IS NOT NULL AND @itemId <> 'ALL')
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT S.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE, M.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
FROM SCM_MST_SITE S
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT I.DIVISION_ID, I.COMPANY_ID, I.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
        FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
       WHERE I.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_TYPE IS NOT NULL
         AND I.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE = 'CELL'
         AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR I.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId)
         AND (@itemId IS NULL OR @itemId = 'ALL' OR I.ITEM_ID = @itemId)) SS
  ON S.DIVISION_ID = SS.DIVISION_ID AND S.OPERATION_GROUP = SS.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
 AND S.COMPANY_ID = SS.COMPANY_ID
JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M
  ON M.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE' AND M.SEGMENT1 = S.SCM_SITE_ID AND M.VALID_YN = 'Y'
WHERE S.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND S.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' AND S.OSP_YN = 'N'
